purpose: Bind Campaign112's zero-candidate decision to v73, distinguish post-exposure operator recombinations from a genuinely new source state, and stop before every Campaign112 protected value.

family_review.synchronous_market_relative_return: Same-clock cross-sectional ranks substitute a post-exposure ordinal operator into the terminal market-relative and Campaign063 state family.
family_review.tick_update_and_reversal: One-tick bounce combines the terminal currency-grid, update, and reversal operators and cannot identify quotes from aggregate minute closes.
family_review.cross_session_profile: A 20-session baseline adds a selected rolling estimator and inherits deterministic early-snapshot cold-start support.
family_review.availability_and_suspension: Provider absence is not an accepted point-in-time suspension event and must remain fail-closed rather than ranked.
family_review.complete_library_model: A tree interaction architecture is a prohibited supervised complete-library retry after Campaign102/Campaign103.
family_review.event_source: The one-day top_list entitlement sample is pending canonicalization and time alignment; it is not an accepted historical source.

known_failed_support_or_semantic_classes.failed_or_rejected_class: cross-sectional percentile-rank state operator and strictly positive leave-one-out variance at every return position
post-exposure raw tick-grid plus adjacent price-update combination
deterministic multi-session or prior-period cold start
complete-library model reweighting, architecture, or aggregator retry

mandatory_prevalue_support_and_source_ga.top_list_source_blocker: Only a one-session entitlement sample exists; exact duplicates remain raw and event timing/canonicalization is not frozen.
mandatory_prevalue_support_and_source_ga.reason: Five proposals failed semantic/support identification and the sole new-source direction lacks an accepted historical point-in-time source. No source, candidate, comparator, daily-price, or return value was opened.

research_efficiency_decision.why: The frozen library already spans marginal, ordered, clock, range, body, gap, amount, volume, transaction-price, market-relative, cross-session, structural, quarterly, event, and complete-library mechanisms. A new operator over those exposed states is not a new information channel.
research_efficiency_decision.safe_next_step: Scout a separately accepted point-in-time source contract without provider rows first; no source may enter a campaign until schema, timing, canonicalization, capacity, and fingerprints are frozen.
